policy.scope: This browser profile and origin only
policy.authority: A local review record is not a repository-wide certification.
policy.futureSharedRecord: A future authenticated Workshop host or reviewed repository change must publish shared verification.

city.title: City destination discovery
city.claim: Selecting a destination reveals its dossier and opens the Mall pavilion through the City-owned entrance.
city.method: Select Singularity Mall on the City map, inspect its dossier, then activate its entry.

city.title: Map layer controls
city.claim: Terrain, land cover, watersheds, districts, parcels, mobility, transit, utilities and hazards can be independently shown or hidden.
city.method: Toggle several map layers and confirm only the corresponding overlay changes.

city.title: District selection and scene
city.claim: Selecting a district updates the selected district and its linked spatial scene.
city.method: Select Civic Quarter and another district; compare the title, index and scene.

city.title: Renderer and visualization channels
city.claim: The City experience can show visualization, textual Renderer output, or both without changing the underlying place identity.
city.method: Switch through all three modes and verify the selected place remains consistent.

city.title: Connected Civic Quarter model
city.claim: The district workbench renders linked synthetic parcels, buildings, public space and network relationships from the City fixture.
city.method: Inspect several entities and toggle mobility, water and energy overlays.

city.title: Singularity Mall entrance
city.claim: The Mall is registered as a Civic Quarter destination and its City entry opens mall.html.
city.method: Select the Mall destination on the map and follow its entry action.

mall.title: Pavilion space directory
mall.claim: The pavilion page loads six stable, inspectable spaces across two conceptual levels.
mall.method: Confirm all six spaces render and select each zone card.

mall.title: Space inspector
mall.claim: Selecting a zone updates its identity, description, type and associated storefront list.
mall.method: Select Arrival Court, Grand Atrium, Maker Promenade and Market Hall; compare the inspector.

mall.title: Economy fixture storefront
mall.claim: Civic Quarter Bakery reads its product information from the shared City Economy fixture without creating a second catalog.
mall.method: Open Civic Quarter Bakery and compare product names, prices and quantities with the linked Economy fixture.

mall.title: Leasing concepts remain disclosed
mall.claim: Maker Studio, Field & Fable and The Greenhouse Table are labelled concepts, not registered merchants or live catalogs.
mall.method: Inspect each proposed tenant and confirm the concept disclosure is visible.
